cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY'
import random, subprocess, sys, os
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from main import canonical_runs, U
random.seed(12345)

def fmt(x): return f'{x:032x}'
for trial in range(300):
    n=random.randint(0,80)
    routes={}
    for _ in range(n):
        length=random.randint(0,128)
        start=random.getrandbits(128)
        size=1<<(128-length)
        start=(start//size)*size
        routes[(start,length)]=random.randint(0,50)
    s,h=canonical_runs(routes)
    lines=['ATLAS '+str(len(routes))]
    for (st,l),hp in routes.items(): lines.append(f'{fmt(st)} {l} {hp}')
    out=subprocess.run(['tmp/engine_test'],input=('\n'.join(lines)+'\n').encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True).stdout.split()
    R=int(out[0]); exp=[fmt(x) for x in s]; exph=[-1 if x is None else x for x in h]
    got=[out[1+2*i].decode() for i in range(R)]; goth=[int(out[2+2*i]) for i in range(R)]
    if exp!=got or exph!=goth:
        print('MISMATCH trial',trial,'n',n,'Rpy',len(s),'Rc',R)
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(exph,goth)):
            if a!=b: print('hop mismatch',i,a,b, exp[i],got[i]); break
        print('exp starts tail',exp[-10:]); print('got starts tail',got[-10:])
        raise SystemExit(1)
print('ATLAS random PASS')
